notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
easyPrerequisites: any creature type chosen with Roaming Throne.
description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Roaming Throne.
Orvar triggers twice, creating two token copies of Roaming Throne.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Roaming Throne.
Orvar triggers four times, creating four token copies of Roaming Throne.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting any nonlegendary permanent you control that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Orvar triggers eight times, creating eight copies of the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the copies of the mana-producing permanent by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
